messages:
elaine_sales: Heads-up 10: Archipelago signed an LOI and wants a 4-week POC. They plan to bring a custom QLoRA-13B variant and need it behind their VPC with strict EU-only residency + BYOK. Asking whether Dedicated or Private is faster to onboard for the POC.
omar_ops: Based on past POCs, Dedicated in eu-west-1 is usually faster to stand up (we control infra), but Private gives them full data residency control. If they require BYOK + HSM, Private has fewer legal hoops but longer setup.
rupert_eng: Technical checklist for adapter-based onboarding: we need adapter tar, base model name, tokenizer.json, special tokens, and a sample of expected request sizes. Also confirm whether their adapter depends on patched ops (custom RMSNorm etc.).
elaine_sales: They said they used a custom RMSNorm patch in training. Is that a red flag?
rupert_eng: Not necessarily, but we must validate runtime kernel compatibility. If it's nonstandard op, Private or Dedicated with a custom kernel build may be required. I can do a quick API-compat scan on the adapter.
sanja_security: Security constraints: customer needs KMS with customer-managed keys, IP allowlist via VPC peering, and annual audit rights. Also they asked for our data handling flow to sign-off SOC2 and GDPR compliance. I'll prepare a redacted flow doc.
liam_prod: For catalog entry proposal (short):
```
catalog_id: custom/archipelago/13b-qlora-v1
deployment_target: dedicated-eu-west-1 or private-eu
quant_profile: qlora-int8-fallback-q4
runtime_flags: continuous_batching=true, kv_cache=true, streaming=true
canary_route: archipelago-poc-canary
```
This will allow us to route tests to a canary pool.
omar_ops: Perf notes: 2k token responses with int8 on 4xA800 gives p95 ~170-210ms depending on batch. If kernel tuning and q4 we might reach ~140ms but needs quick validation.
elaine_sales: Pricing question: customer wants an estimate for 4 weeks, ~30k gen tokens/day plus a couple load tests. Could we give a POC flat-fee + usage?
omar_ops: I'd propose: flat setup fee to cover BYOK/VPC peering work + reserved mini-pool for POC, then usage billed at dedicated rates. I'll draft numbers and send privately.
rupert_eng: Action items: 1) I'll run an adapter-compat scan and post results (by Tue). 2) Omar to prototype a perf harness for the adapter on staging (by Wed). 3) Sanja to assemble security FAQ + GDPR notes (by Wed). 4) Elaine to obtain adapter tar and a small prompt corpus (today).
infra-bot: Ticket created: POC-2012 Archipelago onboarding (assignees: omar_ops, rupert_eng, sanja_security)
elaine_sales: I'll schedule a kickoff with their infra lead tomorrow. If the adapter scan flags native ops, we may need to move to Private and update timelines. Thanks everyone. :smile:
